exposure: Skills-based childbirth preparation program (The Pink Kit Method for Birthing Better)
cohort: The study included 182 first-time mothers in New Zealand who self-selected and met eligibility criteria.
finding: The skills-based childbirth preparation program significantly increased childbirth self-efficacy in the intervention group at 36 weeks gestation compared to control groups.
gest_age: Measurements were taken at 24 weeks and 36 weeks gestation; the study involved pregnant mothers.
